latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of create-colleague skill:

- Instantly distill a colleague into an AI Skill using Feishu/DingTalk data, generating both Work Skill and Persona.
- Supports English and Chinese; auto-detects and responds in user’s language.
- Guides step-by-step through initial info collection and multiple data sourcing methods, including direct paste, file upload, Feishu/DingTalk auto-collection, and document links.
- Handles permissions and tokens for Feishu/DingTalk; provides user instructions for first-time setup and error troubleshooting.
- Allows for continuous skill evolution via update commands and supports listing all generated colleague skills.
